item.title: Essential Scrum: A Practical Guide to the Most Popular Agile Process (Addison-Wesley Signature Series (Cohn))
item.description:
Essential Scrum: A Practical Guide to the Most Popular Agile Process

Summary

“Essential Scrum: A Practical Guide to the Most Popular Agile Process” by Kenneth S. Rubin offers a comprehensive exploration of Scrum, one of the most widely used frameworks within the Agile methodology. The book delves into the Scrum process, rules, and roles, providing an in-depth understanding of its components such as the product backlog, sprint planning, daily scrums, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Rubin emphasizes the real-world application of Scrum, supported by clear explanations, diagrams, and examples. The book serves both beginners and experienced practitioners by structuring information in a practical and accessible manner.

item.title: The Epic Guide to Agile: More Business Value on a Predictable Schedule with Scrum
item.description:
The Epic Guide to Agile: More Business Value on a Predictable Schedule with Scrum

Summary

“The Epic Guide to Agile: More Business Value on a Predictable Schedule with Scrum” by Dave Todaro is a comprehensive resource aimed at helping businesses leverage the Agile framework, specifically Scrum, to enhance productivity and predictability. The book elucidates strategies to deliver greater business value through improved workflow efficiency and team collaboration. Todaro breaks down the Scrum methodology into actionable steps and provides insights on how to overcome common challenges faced by teams and organizations transitioning to Agile practices.
